name: adr-authoring
description: Use this when writing, drafting, or updating an Architecture Decision Record (ADR) or a plan document for this repo — e.g. "write an ADR for X", "record this decision", "author the ADR for this design", "draft the plan doc". Covers the house MADR shape, numbering, the index row, the docs-nav regeneration step, and the VitePress traps that fail the docs build.
